title: Early-Signing Credit on a Home-Site Lease Twelve-Month Renewal
content:
**Home-Site Lease — signing a twelve-month renewal early**

A resident who signs a twelve-month renewal of the Home-Site Lease soon after the renewal offer earns an early-signing credit: a flat dollar amount per month, taken once from the monthly site rent written into the renewal. The credit counts the calendar days from the offer date — the date of the twelve-month renewal offer among the lease's notices — to the signing date.

| Calendar days from the offer date to the signing date | Early-signing credit |
|---|---|
| 14 or fewer | 5.00 per month |
| more than 14 but no more than 30 | 2.50 per month |
| more than 30 | none |

### The boundaries

| Signing day (offer date counted as day 0) | Credit |
|---|---|
| day 0 (signed on the offer date) | 5.00 |
| day 14 | 5.00 |
| day 15 | 2.50 |
| day 30 | 2.50 |
| day 31 | none |

### Questions on the credit

*Is the credit a percentage?* No. It is a flat 5.00 or 2.50 a month.

*Which date starts the count?* The date of the twelve-month renewal offer, as recorded among the lease's notices; the count ends on the signing date.

*Hypothetical figure.* An offer dated 1 July and a signature on 20 July: 19 days, so 2.50 a month is taken once from the rent written into the renewal; a rent of 734.30 becomes 731.80.
